name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's official library of packaged instructions that teach Claude how to do specific jobs, like a set of recipe cards an AI can read before starting a task.
buyer: A developer integrating Claude into a company workflow who needs a starting template for a domain-specific skill instead of writing the instructions from scratch.
business_use_cases: A consultancy adapts one of these skill templates to build a client-specific skill (e.g. brand-compliant document generation) faster than starting blank.
A SaaS company studies the format to design their own in-app 'Claude skill' for their product.
A trainer uses the examples to teach a workshop on building AI skills.

money_ideas.idea: Custom skill-building consulting for companies who want a tailored version.

steal_this: Fork one skill this weekend, tailor it to a specific client's document format, and sell it as a small custom-skill gig.
